summary: Phase 5d: Found and fixed formula defect (interval ssn atom compat filter). Forward proofs rewritten and sorry-free. Backward proof requires composition lemma (Feferman-Vaught for NormalForms) to verify interval witness quantifier parts at depth k >= 1.

blockers.description: Backward proof needs the composition lemma: depth-k n-var NF is determined by all pairwise depth-k 2-var NFs. At depth 0, proven (nf_composition_depth0). At depth k >= 1, the quantifier part of ssn (ssn.2) must match the actual model structure. With char_kp1 for interval witnesses, nf_y.2 provides depth-k 2-var NFs at (z,y), but combining these into the depth-k 3-var NF at (y,x,t) requires the composition lemma by induction on k.
blockers.goal_state: Need nf_eval_nf M k 3 (y,x,t) ssn where ssn : NormalForm sig k 3 with sub_nf.2 ssn = true and atoms matching via filter. At k=0 this is trivial (atoms only). At k >= 1, ssn.2 : NormalForm sig (k-1) 4 -> Bool must match the actual existentials at (z,y,x,t).
